instruction.name: vmaddwev.w.h
instruction.description: Multiply the even-positioned signed 16-bit elements in `b` and the corresponding signed 16-bit elements in `c`, extending both to 32-bit, and add the product to the 32-bit elements in `a`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 4.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vmaddwev.w.h $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vmaddwev.w.h $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vmaddwev.w.h $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vmaddwev.w.h $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vmaddwev.w.h $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vmaddwev.w.h $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vmaddwev.w.h $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vmaddwev.w.h $vr7, $vr15, $vr23
